title: manni content strategy: persona record
description: A content-strategy persona: one concrete reader within an audience. One record per file, under docs/content-strategy/personas/. Every field after `type`, `id` and `audience` is optional.

type.description: Marks the file as a persona record, which `manni strategy` reads.

id.description: The id pages and other records name this record by. Unique across every record.

title.description: The record's name, as `manni strategy list` and `get` show it.

description.description: One sentence that says who or what the record is.

name.description: The persona's name and role, as a reader would say it.

audience.description: The id of the audience record this persona belongs to. `manni strategy` builds its tree from this field.

team-context.description: The team and product the persona works in.

proficiency.description: What the persona is already good at.

prerequisites.description: What the persona needs to know before the docs can help.

goals.description: What the persona is trying to achieve.

pains.description: What gets in the persona's way.

constraints.description: What the persona avoids or insists on, one sentence each. `manni test tasks` tells them to the synthetic user, and judges each one after the run as a warning.

content-types.description: The kinds of content the persona needs.

journeys.description: The ids of the journey records this persona follows. `manni strategy` derives the same list from each journey's `personas:`, so this one is optional.
